style: Preserve this detailed psychedelic illustrated painting, clean outlines, silver hair, cyan and gold ornamental temple, vivid controlled colors, stable facial identities and anatomy. Continuous full-frame animation, fixed camera, unchanged framing.

shots.prompt: The central white-bearded elder immediately raises his right hand above the glowing drum, strikes the drumhead with his palm, lifts it and strikes again. His forearm and wrist visibly bend through each strike; his left hand alternates on the drum. The seated companions gently sway their shoulders and nod while staying in their places. Flames under the drum rise and curl, individual sparks drift upward. One continuous view of the same five people. The figures move independently of the background.

The same central elder continues alternating palm strikes on the same drum, with clearly visible arm motion. Thin golden streams emerge from the vibrating drumhead and curl upward between his hands into one slowly turning spiral. The same companions follow the spiral with their eyes and sway, hair and cloth move softly. Maintain the same people, positions, drum and temple. The energy grows from the existing sparks; no cut or sudden substitution.

The elder keeps drumming visibly as the existing golden spiral opens into a luminous clock ring hovering immediately above the drum. Two distinct clock hands rotate within the ring, the ring made from the same flowing gold sparks. The companions lean toward it and continue swaying, keeping their identities and seated places. The physical drum, moving hands and temple remain visible throughout. Continuous evolution from spiral to clock, no scene replacement.
